name: Nightcrawler
notes: Kurt Wagner was raised by Romany travelers in Eastern Europe before joining the X-Men. Despite his "demonic" appearance he has a light heart and a buoyant, outgoing persona. He is a devout Christian (you say what that means). He is close to all the other X-Men.

kit.name: The Daredevil
always: When you take an unnecessary risk for the sheer thrill of it, gain one Daredevil Token.
You may spend two Daredevil Tokens for Advantage on a daring skill roll.

powers.name: Daredevil's Luck
powers.text: You may spend 1–3 Daredevil Tokens (GM sets the cost) to introduce a plot twist that allows a story problem to be solved by Daredevilish means.

powers.name: All Heart
powers.text: In combat you may spend 2 Daredevil Tokens to ignore injuries and penalties for one turn.

powers.name: Striker
powers.effect: You do extra damage on your attacks. Included in the Attack table rider.

powers.name: Fuzzy Elf
powers.effect: Darkvision. You move by Teleporting. Ignore Obstacles and don't grant Opportunities.

powers.name: Teleport Away
powers.effect: Trigger: You may save your unused move and use it on someone else's turn once/round.

powers.name: Duel
powers.effect: One enemy within R10 becomes your Target. Against them, 2s count as 4s (i.e. hits). Special: This power recharges when your Target is Taken Out.

powers.name: Change Target
powers.effect: Trigger: Make a Basic Attack against a creature, then make them the target of Duel.

powers.name: Focused Attack
powers.effect: Trigger: At the start of your turn, your Target gains one point of Focus. Then pick Focus-many problems for the Target; to ignore them, they must grant you an Opportunity: Harried (Disadvantage on saves + escape attempts); cannot benefit from their allies' powers; cannot use Opportunities; cannot benefit from their own powers; cannot use Interrupts or Reactions.

powers.name: Strike Back
powers.effect: Trigger: When an enemy attack hits, spend an Action Point to counterattack.

powers.name: Teleport Attack
powers.effect: You move adjacent to your target. This counts as an HTH attack.

powers.name: Flicker Attack
powers.effect: If you use this to attack your Target, they gain +1 point of Focus.

powers.name: Exploit Weakness
powers.effect: The target of this attack gains Vulnerable 1 to all damage with you as the source.

powers.name: Teleporting Flurry
powers.effect: The target of this attack gains Disadvantage to attack you for the rest of the Encounter. Each time it successfully hits you it may Save against this condition.

powers.name: Bamf! Bamf! Bamf!
powers.effect: Deal 2✸ to each adjacent enemy and shift 1 square.

role_actions.name: Rally
role_actions.effect: Spend 1 Action Point: Heal 4 HP. Regain one Encounter power.
